svg.title: Gantry desktop workspace — visual proposal, not implemented
svg.desc: Illustrative macOS-style dark workspace. A compact toolbar, source sidebar, dense sandbox list, selected-object inspector, context menu, and activity drawer. All names and operation records are sample data.
svg.text: Same manager. Same safeguards. A more desktop-oriented interaction model.

svg.text: One compact toolbar. No banner or giant page title.
Source → list → inspector. Actions stay on the item.
Context menus, shortcuts, and an activity drawer.
LAYOUT STUDY ONLY — not running GPUI, not a new web frontend. Existing Go validation and source-bound writes stay intact.
